display.purpose: Hero-level repair promises and decisive conversion messages.

label.purpose: Short status or context labels only.

shadows.name: interactive-lift
shadows.purpose: Subtle hover feedback for an interactive service card only.

motion.name: standard-out
motion.purpose: Primary easing for compact interaction feedback.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: GSAP entrance reveal for visible-by-default section content.

components.name: Primary Call Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--primary, #2259C6); color: var(--primary-foreground, #FFFFFF); font: 600 14px/1 Geist, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1D4BAC; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(62,109,183,.45); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Outline WhatsApp Button
components.description: The visible secondary contact route when calling is primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { min-height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #E3E6EA); border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--background, #F9F9FA); color: var(--foreground, #121A26); font: 600 14px/1 Geist, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), color 180ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: var(--primary, #2259C6); color: var(--primary, #2259C6); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(62,109,183,.45); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Service Card
components.css: .ds-service-card { display: grid; gap: 8px; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--secondary, #E3E8EF); color: var(--foreground, #121A26); font-family: Geist, sans-serif; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-service-card strong { font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-service-card span { color: var(--muted-foreground, #667180); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-service-card:hover { border-color: rgba(34,89,198,.3); box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(18,26,38,.10); }

components.name: Trust Pill
components.description: A compact factual proof cue for a rating, guarantee, or service status.
components.css: .ds-trust-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(34,89,198,.10); color: var(--primary, #2259C6); font: 600 12px/1.2 Geist, sans-serif; }

components.name: Mobile Action Bar
components.description: Sticky mobile conversion strip with call first and WhatsApp second.
components.css: .ds-mobile-bar { display: flex; gap: 12px; padding: 12px; background: #FFFFFF; border-top: 1px solid var(--border, #E3E6EA); font-family: Geist, sans-serif; } .ds-mobile-bar button { flex: 1; min-height: 32px; border-radius: 9999px; font: 600 14px/1 Geist, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-mobile-bar button:first-child { border: 0; background: var(--primary, #2259C6); color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-mobile-bar button:last-child { border: 1px solid var(--border, #E3E6EA); background: #FFFFFF; color: var(--foreground, #121A26); } .ds-mobile-bar button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(62,109,183,.45); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: Hindustan Care should feel like a capable local service team that answers promptly and communicates without ambiguity. The interface is bright, blue-led, and composed around clear paths to a phone call; it earns premium credibility through tidy structure and useful proof, not through spectacle.
keyCharacteristics: Cool, service-led blue with clean neutral space
Structural borders and tonal surfaces before shadow
Rounded but compact everyday service components
Responsive, readable information under household urgency

rules.name: The Service Blue Rule
rules.body: Service Blue is reserved for actions, confirmations, and high-confidence signals. Do not spread it across entire screens or use it as decoration.

rules.name: The Clear-Surface Rule
rules.body: Neutral backgrounds do the organising. Use soft tonal shifts and borders to separate content; heavy shadows are not a substitute for hierarchy.

rules.name: The Fast Read Rule
rules.body: A visitor should understand the service, the local relevance, and how to call before they need to parse supporting detail.

rules.name: The Proof-First Rule
rules.body: Ratings, service language, and clear pricing promises create trust; depth effects never do the job of evidence.

dos: Do make the phone action immediately visible and pair it with a clear WhatsApp fallback.
Do use Service Blue for decisive actions, trusted local signals, and active states.
Do rely on testimonials and ratings that the business can substantiate.
Do preserve generous section spacing and readable body line length.
Do use `prefers-reduced-motion` alternatives for all GSAP-driven motion.
donts: Don't make the site resemble a cheap local repair directory.
Don't ship generic WordPress-template visuals or outdated government-style layouts.
Don't use an overly flashy startup landing-page aesthetic, gradient text, decorative glass panels, or hero-metric templates.
Don't use large soft shadows with bordered cards, side-stripe accents, or card radii above 16px.
Don't hide key service information behind motion or depend on animation for content to become visible.
